reason: B better targets the as-solidified alloy’s genuinely dynamic regime and proposes a controlled Co-free versus Co-containing comparison across quasi-static and SHPB rates, with measurable rate sensitivity and serration predictions. Its phonon-drag attribution still requires more direct discrimination from adiabatic heating or twinning, but A largely transposes established hot-deformation DRV/DRX behavior from compositionally different alloys and incorrectly treats DRV as favored at lower temperature/higher rate.
